svg.title: Wollastonite phase fraction during SBF immersion for ceramics sintered at 700 to 1100 °C
svg.desc: Left: wollastonite weight percent versus immersion time. Right: change relative to day 0.
svg.text: Wollastonite stability in simulated body fluid
Phase fraction of bioactive silicate ceramics sintered at 700–1100 °C, followed over 21 days of SBF immersion
Mass-loss kinetics (power-law fit): 700 °C, n = 0.25 (quasi-Fickian); 1100 °C, n = 0.58 (anomalous transport).
Wollastonite fraction is set mainly by sintering temperature; after day 3 it stays varies by less than 1.7 wt% (day 3–21) at every temperature.
